title: The ℓ¹-Bass conjecture for all discrete groups

result.label: The ℓ¹-Bass conjecture for all discrete groups
result.statement: Proves the ℓ 1 -Bass conjecture for every discrete group: Hattori–Stallings traces of idempotent matrices over ^1(G) are supported on finitely many finite-order conjugacy classes. The algebraic companion proves the integral Bass trace conjecture and Kaplansky's idempotent conjecture for torsion-free groups over every commutative unital characteristic-zero domain.
